name: Sobrina
source:
Very cold, crisp and rigid.
She doesn't seem very flexible.
She compensates for the sloppiness of the director, Nulonsky.
She is a good human family man, but she is too loyal to his duties and can be a bit fussy and detailed.

These are the rules, and you will obey them."
